title: Barton Springs bathhouse: the price climbed
subtitle: Millions of dollars, from the 2023 estimate to today's total appropriations
source: KUT News, from City of Austin records
alt: Bar chart of the Barton Springs bathhouse rehabilitation's cost, as reported by KUT: city staff estimated about $9.3 million in early 2023; the lower construction bid was $16.9 million; the City Council approved an $18.6 million contract; total appropriations including design and exhibits now stand at $21.98 million.
